On.bar_b_note: Large armoured badger reads well, but the heavy yellow-olive grade, no sky or distance in the combat camera, and flat gold sunburst discs and lavender arcs put it well below Palworld's finish.

Bc.bar_b_note: The appealing, well-shaded elder villager with readable eyes and an earthy palette is at shipping character finish; the neutral stage means light and atmosphere cannot be judged.

Qo.bar_b_note: Smeared, low-detail grass ground, sparse lollipop trees, flat noon light and empty horizons sink it, even though B's torn-down banners and smoke tell a real aftermath.

Uc.bar_b_note: Close top-down grass framing with a yellow grade, no sky, and flat lavender arc/cone telegraphs that cover half the frame read as prototype, not Palworld-class combat.

Di.bar_b_note: The creatures hold static poses under oversized gold hit discs and lavender cones, with a muddy yellow-green grade and no atmospheric depth.

Lx.bar_b_note: The armoured boar has a solid naturalistic silhouette and good scale, but dark, low-contrast plate materials with no rim light, and faint poses that collapse into a black blob, fall short of the owner's creature bar.

Tf.bar_b_note: For most frames the camera shows only grass and a small hamster while the opponent is off screen, so there is no world, sky or light to carry it.

Jx.bar_b_note: Murky brown-black frames with no purple storm sky or lightning, debug panels covering a third of each frame, flat magenta outline telegraphs and an invisible player creature sink it.

top_changes.change: Add real hit-react, stagger and locomotion lean animation (additive flinch/recoil layer) so the small player creature and the badger break their idle silhouette when struck or moving in every Meadows fight.

Replace the flat gold sunburst discs and screen-filling lavender arc/cone/outline telegraphs with grounded, creature-scaled VFX (dust, stone chips, sparks, ground scorch) and a ground-hugging tell sized under the creature; remove the debug panels from the Stormwood captures.

Re-frame and re-grade the combat camera: pull it back and lower it so both fighters, the sky and blue distance are in shot, cut the yellow-olive cast for warm grass/cool distance, add rim light on creatures and fade occluding trunks and canopy in Stormwood under a fixed purple storm sky.
